title: Design, Development and Demonstration of a Centralized Protection and Monitoring (CPM) System within a Distribution Substation including DER
scope_text: Grant: ₹192.50 Lakhs (2023–2025). Replaces multiple standalone bay-level Intelligent Electronic Devices (IEDs) with a single high-performance centralized protection and monitoring server compliant with IEC 61850-9-2 Process Bus and GOOSE messaging. Integrates Distributed Energy Resource Management System (DERMS) logic to handle bidirectional fault currents and dynamic topology changes; successfully commissioned and demonstrated at the IIT Bhubaneswar 33/11 kV campus substation.

title: Centre of Excellence on Energy Aware Urban Infrastructure
scope_text: Grant: ₹49.04 Lakhs (2023–2028, Multi-Institutional CoE with IIT Kharagpur). Develops cyber-physical architectures for energy-aware smart cities, combining smart-meter Advanced Metering Infrastructure (AMI) analytics, automated demand-response scheduling, building energy management systems (BEMS), and distribution grid resilience under extreme weather and peak-load conditions.

title: Development of Coordinated Protection and Control Scheme for Microgrid
funding_agency: SERB Science and Technology Award for Research
scope_text: Grant: ₹38.50 Lakhs (2022–2025, SERB STAR Award). Addresses protection blinding, sympathetic tripping, and low fault-current levels in inverter-dominated AC/DC microgrids. Develops a dual-layer adaptive protection and droop-based hierarchical control scheme that dynamically updates relay settings during seamless transitions between grid-connected and islanded modes.

title: Development of IoT Enabled Phasor and Power Quality Monitoring Devices for Smart Power Grids
scope_text: Grant: ₹29.24 Lakhs (2021–2024). Designs and fabricates low-cost, edge-enabled micro-Phasor Measurement Units (uPMUs) and power quality analyzers using embedded DSP/ARM cores. Evaluates synchrophasor phase angles, Total Harmonic Distortion (THD), voltage sag/swell, and frequency excursions in real time over MQTT/IoT cloud dashboards for distribution feeders.

title: Design and Development of Dynamic phasor and Frequency estimator complying IEEE C37.118 standard
scope_text: Grant: ₹18.30 Lakhs (2019–2023). Formulates computationally efficient Taylor-Fourier and adaptive filtering algorithms to estimate dynamic synchrophasors, frequency, and Rate of Change of Frequency (ROCOF) under off-nominal oscillations and harmonic distortion. Implemented on FPGA hardware to strictly meet IEEE C37.118.1 P-class and M-class latency and Total Vector Error (TVE) compliance.

title: Smart Grid Visualization - Applications of Virtual Reality
scope_text: Grant: ₹20.00 Lakhs (2020–2023). Builds an interactive 3D Virtual Reality (VR) digital twin of power substations and distribution feeders using Unity3D and real-time SCADA/PMU data streams. Enables grid operators to visualize voltage contours, thermal loading, and fault propagation in immersive 3D space for rapid situational awareness.

title: Design and Development of Grid Interactive Adaptive Controls for Frequency Regulation from Large Scale PV Systems
scope_text: Grant: ₹39.16 Lakhs (3 Years). Develops grid-forming and grid-following adaptive inverter control loops that emulate synthetic inertia and primary frequency droop in utility-scale solar PV plants. Operates PV arrays with dynamic active-power reserve headroom (deloaded MPPT) to arrest grid frequency nadir during sudden generator trips or load surges.

title: Reliability Enhancement in PV Rich Microgrids with Plug-in-Hybrid EVs and Data Centres
Grid Interconnection protocols for Largely Dispersed minigrids/microgrids
Intelligent DC Microgrid
Audit for 33kV Power Supply Work
scope_text: Grant: ₹2.50 Lakhs (Consultancy). Conducts a comprehensive electrical engineering audit of the 33 kV incoming feeder, outdoor switchyard, VCB protection relay coordination, earthing grid resistance, lightning arresters, and transformer insulation parameters for the permanent campus of IISER Berhampur.

title: AR-VR Based Application Modules for Learning, Manpower Training and Emergency Response in Electrical Substations
scope_text: Grant: ₹8.00 Lakhs (3 Years). Creates gamified Augmented and Virtual Reality (AR/VR) training simulators for electrical substation personnel. Covers standard operating procedures (SOPs) for isolator/circuit-breaker interlocking, LOTO (Lockout-Tagout) safety protocols, arc-flash hazard mitigation, and emergency fault restoration.

title: Vetting of Guidelines for Solar Powered Fencing
funding_agency: Dept. of Energy, Govt. of Odisha
scope_text: Institutional Consultancy (Dept. of Energy, Govt. of Odisha). Performs technical verification and safety standardization of solar-powered electric fencing guidelines (primarily used for human-wildlife conflict mitigation). Evaluates high-voltage impulse energizer energy limits (Joules), pulse duration, earthing layout, and IEC 60335-2-76 human safety compliance.

title: Power Quality Enhancement and Control of Distributed Generation in Grid Interactive Systems
Design and Development of Affordable Movable Solar PV Water Pumping System
UK India Clean Energy Research Institute (WP-4)
Design and Implementation of High Speed Low Power Embedded Signal Processor Based Custom Devices for PQ Improvement
Renewable Energy EMPOWERing European and InDian communities (RE-EMPOWERED)
scope_text: Indo-EU Horizon 2020 Collaborative Grant. Designs multi-vector local energy grids combining solar PV, biomass, battery storage, and clean cooking/thermal loads. Features custom power-electronic interfaces, cloud-based eco-tool energy management, and a live rural microgrid field deployment in Keonjhar district, Odisha.

title: Cost-Effective Floating-Solar Energy Generation Technologies for Nearly Zero-Energy Villages
scope_text: DST-SERD Sponsored Project. Investigates pontoon-mounted floating solar photovoltaic (FSPV) systems on rural water bodies to conserve agricultural land and leverage evaporative cooling for higher cell efficiency. Includes corrosion-resistant cabling, high-gain DC-DC converters, and standalone microgrid sizing for net-zero energy villages.

title: Adapting FDM for additive manufacturing of aluminium alloys in the semisolid state
scope_text: Interdisciplinary DST-SERB Project. Retrofits Fused Deposition Modelling (FDM) 3D-printing extruders with precision induction/resistive heating and closed-loop PID temperature-shear control to process aluminium alloys in the thixotropic semisolid temperature regime, overcoming wire-feeding buckling and porosity defects.

title: Grid-tied multilevel photovoltaic inverter with batteries power balancing
UVC Disinfection Chamber
Vetting of Schematic Drawing with transmission loss calculation for 6.6KV/415V OHDC line

Vetting of Electrical and E&M Designs - Puri-Ganjam Project
scope_text: Industrial Consultancy (M/s GVPR Engineers Ltd). Technical proof-checking and design vetting of HT/LT electrical substations, power transformers, HT induction motor pump drives, APFC panels, and PLC/SCADA telemetry for the mega rural piped water supply scheme across Puri and Ganjam districts.

title: Vetting of Electrical and E&M Designs - Nayagarh Project
scope_text: Industrial Consultancy (M/s GVPR Engineers Ltd). Evaluates short-circuit withstand ratings, voltage drop calculations, cable sizing, soft-starter/VFD harmonic mitigation, and earthing mat designs for intake wells and water treatment plants in the Nayagarh mega water supply project.

title: Vetting of Electrical and E&M Designs - Nawarangpur Project
scope_text: Industrial Consultancy (M/s GVPR Engineers Ltd). Vets Single Line Diagrams (SLDs), relay protection grading, standby diesel generator synchronization, and electro-mechanical pumping machinery specifications for the Nabarangpur district water supply infrastructure.

title: Vetting of Electrical and E&M Designs - Nayagarh, Angul, Jajpur Project
scope_text: Industrial Consultancy (Kalpataru Projects International Ltd). Multi-district electro-mechanical and power distribution design audit covering substation layout, surge protection, motor control centers (MCC), and energy-efficient pumping hydraulics across Nayagarh, Angul, and Jajpur.

title: Vetting of civil structural, electrical, mechanical and instrumentation design - 3 rural piped water supply projects (Koraput, Nabarangpur)
scope_text: Industrial Consultancy (L&T Infrastructure). End-to-end multidisciplinary design audit covering civil hydraulic structures, 33/11 kV electrical substations, centrifugal pump-motor transient analysis (water hammer vs VFD ramp rates), and industrial IoT/SCADA instrumentation for three rural water projects in Koraput and Nabarangpur.

title: Execution of Rural Piped water supply project, Ranipada Cluster, Banpur Block, Khurda (incl. 5 yr O&M)
scope_text: Industrial Consultancy (UMSL Ltd). Provides third-party quality assurance, electrical commissioning verification, pump-motor efficiency testing, and a 5-year Operations & Maintenance (O&M) reliability framework for the Ranipada cluster piped water supply project in Banpur Block, Khurda.

title: Development of adaptive motor controller for PMSM based three-wheel Electric Vehicle
scope_text: MeitY Sponsored Project. Develops a ruggedized, low-cost digital motor controller for Permanent Magnet Synchronous Motors (PMSM) used in Indian L3/L5 electric three-wheelers (e-rickshaws/autos). Implements adaptive Field-Oriented Control (FOC), Maximum Torque Per Ampere (MTPA), field weakening, and regenerative braking under varying payload and road-grade dynamics.

title: Cost-effective energy management strategies for a green hydrogen based EV charging station
scope_text: DST-TARE Project. Formulates techno-economic day-ahead and real-time energy management algorithms for a hybrid EV charging station backed by solar PV, a PEM water electrolyzer, pressurized hydrogen storage tanks, and a PEM fuel cell. Minimizes grid peak-demand charges and optimizes green hydrogen dispatch.

title: Photovoltaic assisted water harvesting from moisture
scope_text: DST Sponsored Project. Designs an off-grid solar-PV driven Atmospheric Water Generator (AWG) that extracts potable water from humid air. Couples MPPT-controlled DC-DC converters directly to solid-state Peltier thermoelectric coolers and hydrophobic/hydrophilic biomimetic condensation surfaces without battery storage bottlenecks.

Comparison of control techniques for residential PV system with module based MPPT
Optimized Modulation for Triple Active Bridge Converter for EV Application with wide-band gap devices
scope_text: DST-SERB Project. Investigates a three-port galvancially isolated Triple Active Bridge (TAB) DC-DC converter integrating Silicon Carbide (SiC) and Gallium Nitride (GaN) wide-bandgap switches for EV onboard power distribution (linking HV traction battery, LV auxiliary bus, and grid/PV port). Uses generalized multi-phase-shift modulation to guarantee Zero Voltage Switching (ZVS) and minimize transformer RMS currents.

title: Design, development and analysis of Integrated Dual-Output Converter (IDOC) Technology for Renewable Integration
Quadratic boost converter based multi-input power converter for renewable applications
Solar-PV integrated On-board and Off-board Electric-Rickshaw Charging Infrastructure
scope_text: Grant: ₹78.00 Lakhs (3 Years, DST-SERD). Develops dual-stage power converter hardware for e-rickshaw charging infrastructure: (1) a high-efficiency off-board solar-PV-to-battery charging station with grid backup, and (2) an integrated on-board charger utilizing the vehicle's traction motor windings as filter inductors to reduce weight and cost.

title: Next Generation Cost Effective Reconfigurable On-Board Battery Charger with Health and Fault Monitoring
scope_text: MeitY Sponsored Project. Builds a reconfigurable multi-port On-Board Charger (OBC) capable of switching between AC grid charging, DC fast charging, and HV-to-LV auxiliary power delivery. Integrates online Electrochemical Impedance Spectroscopy (EIS) ripple injection to estimate battery State-of-Health (SoH) and detect internal cell faults without extra sensors.

title: Integrated three-phase AC-DC bidirectional converter for charging of electric vehicle (EV)
scope_text: Grant: ₹20.00 Lakhs (IIT Bhubaneswar Seed Grant). Designs a compact, high-power-density three-phase bidirectional AC-DC converter with unity Power Factor Correction (PFC) and low Total Harmonic Distortion (<5%). Enables seamless Grid-to-Vehicle (G2V) fast charging and Vehicle-to-Grid (V2G) reactive/active power support.

title: Efficient cache aided data delivery using deep reinforcement learning
Optimization of Service Completion Time for Distributed Gradient Descent in the Presence of Straggler Nodes
Classical and Quantum Error Correcting Codes and Mathematics over Finite Fields for Smart Telecommunications
scope_text: Grant: ₹104.35 Lakhs (3 Years, DST). Explores algebraic coding theory over finite fields and rings to construct high-rate, low-latency classical codes (LDPC, Polar, and Regenerating codes) and Quantum Error-Correcting Codes (QECC / stabilizer and surface codes) for ultra-reliable 6G and quantum communication networks.

title: Communication Efficient Gradient Aggregation for Hierarchical Networks
scope_text: Grant: ₹39.48 Lakhs (3 Years, DST). Tackles the straggler effect and uplink bandwidth bottleneck in hierarchical Federated Learning (Edge-to-Fog-to-Cloud). Uses coding-theoretic gradient compression, over-the-air computation, and quantized aggregation to accelerate distributed deep neural network training.

title: Effect of Fading Correlation on the Performance of Equal Gain Combining Receiver over Hoyt Fading Channels
Aeronautical Telemetry Estimation and Equalization
AI powered autonomous underwater vehicle (AUV) and IoT enabled underwater acoustic sensor networks
scope_text: Grant: ₹90.00 Lakhs (2022–2026, TIH IIT Guwahati). Develops an AI-guided Autonomous Underwater Vehicle (AUV) equipped with custom piezoelectric acoustic modems. Addresses severe multipath fading, Doppler spread, and low sound-speed propagation in shallow water to create a reliable Underwater Acoustic Sensor Network (UASN) for defense and marine monitoring.

title: Achieving Reliable communications in the Internet of Things: An erasure correction coding approach
Light weight, Reconfigurable Cognitive Radio Platform for M2M and IoT applications
scope_text: Grant: ₹81.98 Lakhs (3 Years, IMPRINT-II). Designs a low-SWaP (Size, Weight, and Power) Software-Defined Radio (SDR) cognitive radio platform on Zynq FPGA/RF transceivers. Implements real-time wideband spectrum sensing (energy/cyclostationary detection) and dynamic spectrum access for dense Machine-to-Machine (M2M) and industrial IoT networks.

title: Speech to Speech Translation for Tribal Languages using Deep Learning Framework
scope_text: MeitY Bhashini / Consortia Project. Collects field speech corpora and builds end-to-end deep learning pipelines—combining self-supervised Automatic Speech Recognition (ASR), low-resource Neural Machine Translation (NMT), and expressive Text-to-Speech (TTS) synthesis—for endangered and low-resource tribal languages of Odisha (e.g., Santali, Kui, Mundari, Ho).

title: Design and implementation of MIMO based transceiver for emergency applications
Speech enhancement for hearing impaired listeners
scope_text: DST INSPIRE Faculty Project. Develops ultra-low-latency (<10 ms) speech enhancement, dynamic range compression, and dichotic/binaural signal processing algorithms tailored to sensorineural hearing loss profiles. Suppresses non-stationary babble and traffic noise while preserving consonant-vowel transition cues for digital hearing aids.

title: Multi Channel speech enhancement and noise suppression using beamforming
scope_text: Grant: ₹20.00 Lakhs (IIT Bhubaneswar Seed Grant). Formulates adaptive acoustic beamforming (MVDR and Generalized Sidelobe Canceller) combined with deep complex-valued spectral masking across circular and linear microphone arrays to achieve robust far-field speech dereverberation and multi-speaker noise suppression.

title: Automated prediction of hearing loss and loudness growth curve using EEG signals
scope_text: SERB-SRG Project. Establishes an objective audiometry framework for infants and non-cooperative patients by recording non-invasive scalp Electroencephalography (EEG) responses (Auditory Brainstem Response and ASSR) to modulated acoustic stimuli, using deep neural networks to reconstruct hearing loss audiograms and loudness growth curves.

title: Real Time Implementation of Image Fusion Algorithms for IR and CCD Video
Online Target Scoring System for Consistency Trials with Scintillation removal in images
Design and Development of Deep Learning based App for Early Warning of Blindness
scope_text: SERB Sponsored Project. Develops pruned, quantized Convolutional and Vision Transformer architectures capable of running offline on smartphones connected to portable fundus cameras. Automatically segments optic disc/cup ratios, microaneurysms, and exudates for early mass-screening of diabetic retinopathy and glaucoma.

title: Cancer Modelling of Signaling Network and Prediction of Therapeutic Intervention Strategies
scope_text: DST Sponsored Project. Models intracellular protein-protein interaction and gene regulatory cancer pathways using Probabilistic Boolean Networks (PBN) and Markov chains. Simulates state-space transitions to mathematically identify minimal multi-drug combinations that steer cancerous cell states back toward apoptosis (programmed cell death).

title: Proof of concept for co-ordinate determination of fall of shot from aerial imagery
scope_text: DRDO Sponsored Defence Project. Develops real-time aerial computer vision algorithms for Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAVs) observing artillery firing ranges. Detects transient smoke plumes and crater blasts, compensates for gimbal camera ego-motion, and computes precise GPS/UTM impact coordinates (Fall-of-Shot) for automated fire-control correction.

Design of QoS-aware gateway for reliable IoT communication networks
Elevating the Quality of Education in ICT towards 2030 through Multilateral Collaborations

Multilateral academic and research partnership between IIT Bhubaneswar and leading Norwegian universities (e.g., NTNU/UiA). Funds joint PhD/Master's student mobility, summer schools, and collaborative coursework in 5G/6G ICT, cybersecurity, and edge intelligence.

Efficient, Smart, and Scalable Communication Protocols for Large, Heterogeneous IoT-System
scope_text: Grant: ₹55.00 Lakhs (5 Years, PMRF Research Grant). Rethinks traditional CSMA/CA collision-avoidance by exploiting constructive interference and concurrent transmissions (Synchronous Flooding) at the physical/MAC layer. Achieves deterministic, ultra-low-latency, and scalable many-to-many communication across thousands of heterogeneous IoT nodes.

title: Efficient Framework for Decentralized Real-Time Coordination and Collaboration for a Swarm of Autonomous Robots
scope_text: Grant: ₹30.20 Lakhs (3 Years, DST-SERB CRG). Co-designs decentralized control laws and synchronous wireless network protocols so a swarm of autonomous ground/aerial robots can exchange state vectors within sub-millisecond time slots—enabling collision-free flocking, perimeter surveillance, and resilient consensus without a central base station.

Design and Development of a Doppler Radar System for Inbore Measurement
scope_text: ARMREB-DRDO Project (Commenced 2022). Designs a specialized millimeter-wave / microwave continuous-wave Doppler radar system mounted at the muzzle of large-caliber artillery guns. Captures high-speed frequency-shifted echoes inside the gun barrel to reconstruct real-time projectile velocity, acceleration, and internal ballistic pressure curves.

title: Innovative Biosensor Platform Utilizing Hybrid Fiber Interferometry
scope_text: SERB-CRG Project (Commenced 2024). Fabricates hybrid Mach-Zehnder and Fabry-Perot optical fiber interferometers functionalized with plasmonic/nanomaterial coatings. Measures femtometer-scale refractive index shifts induced by antigen-antibody binding for rapid, label-free point-of-care biosensing.

title: Multiband Shared Aperture Antenna Array Synthesis and Analysis for Radar Platform
scope_text: CARS / LRDE DRDO Project (Commenced 2024). Synthesizes interleaved and stacked shared-aperture phased array antennas capable of simultaneous operation across multiple radar bands (e.g., S/X or L/C bands). Employs metamaterial decoupling structures to suppress cross-band mutual coupling and grating lobes on compact airborne/ground radar panels.

title: Development of Ghat Road Warning System
scope_text: State Transport Authority (STA), Govt. of Odisha (Commenced 2021). Develops an all-weather, solar-powered FMCW radar and wireless transceiver network deployed at blind hairpin bends on accident-prone Odisha ghat roads. Detects approaching vehicles, estimates speed/lane occupancy through fog and foliage, and triggers real-time LED/audio alerts on the opposite curve.

title: High directivity microstrip couplers using distributed realization of lumped elements
Single chip testsets for portable network analyzers for 5G applications
Low cost, lightweight, USB controlled RF synthesizer using broadband band-pass filters with tunable passband
scope_text: DST-SERB Project. Replaces bulky, expensive benchtop microwave signal generators with a palm-sized, USB-controlled wideband RF frequency synthesizer. Combines fractional-N PLL synthesizers with varactor-tuned planar microstrip bandpass filters to suppress harmonics and spurious emissions across a continuously tunable passband.

title: Time domain measurement technique for very low frequency (10-50 MHz) antenna radiation pattern measurements
scope_text: SAC-ISRO RESPOND Project (Commenced 2025). Solves the challenge of measuring radiation patterns of physically large Very Low Frequency / Very High Frequency (10–50 MHz) spaceborne radar and ionospheric sounding antennas, where standard indoor anechoic chambers fail due to massive wavelengths. Uses UWB impulse excitation and time-domain gating on outdoor ranges to mathematically window out ground reflections.

title: Tunable bandpass filters for L-, S-, and C-bands for Radar applications
scope_text: LRDE-DRDO Sponsored Project. Designs compact, high-selectivity electronically tunable planar and substrate-integrated waveguide (SIW) bandpass filters covering L (1–2 GHz), S (2–4 GHz), and C (4–8 GHz) radar bands. Achieves constant fractional bandwidth, low insertion loss, and high linearity for frequency-agile radar front-ends.

title: Virtual Class Room Development
Speech-Based Access of Agricultural Commodity Prices and Weather Information in Indian Languages - Odiya
Design and Development of RF Front-End SoC (RFFE-SoC)
scope_text: Grant: ₹210.00 Lakhs (2024–2027, DLRL DRDO). End-to-end silicon design, foundry tape-out, and QFN/BGA packaging of an indigenous wideband CMOS RF Front-End System-on-Chip (RFFE-SoC). Integrates a noise-canceling Low-Noise Amplifier (LNA), high-isolation T/R switches, digitally programmable attenuators, and driver amplifiers for Electronic Warfare (EW) receivers.

title: Single Stage Up/Down Converter based RFSoC in 1.2 V, 65 nm CMOS for L and S-band Radar
scope_text: Grant: ₹291.00 Lakhs (2024–2027, LRDE DRDO). Tape-out of a 1.2 V, 65 nm CMOS single-stage direct up/down-conversion RF System-on-Chip (8 mm × 8 mm die) for L-band and S-band active phased-array radars. Integrates quadrature mixers, low-phase-noise fractional-N PLL synthesizer, baseband programmable gain filters, and high-speed ADC/DAC interfaces.

title: Dual Band Transceiver SoC
scope_text: Grant: ₹290.00 Lakhs (2024–2027, DEAL DRDO). Develops a fully monolithic dual-band CMOS RF transceiver SoC supporting simultaneous or switchable tactical military communication bands. Features on-chip image-reject mixing, wide dynamic range automatic gain control (AGC), and built-in self-test (BIST) calibration.

title: Scientific and Technical Consultancy - MosArt Labs
scope_text: Grant: ₹41.60 Lakhs (2024–2027, MosArt Labs). Long-term industry-academia R&D consultancy delivering custom analog/RF IC architectures, schematic-to-GDSII physical layout verification, post-layout electromagnetic extraction, and silicon bring-up for commercial mixed-signal semiconductor products.

title: Marquee Semiconductor MoU
scope_text: Grant: ~₹49.00 Lakhs (2023–2027, Marquee Semiconductor MoU). Sponsored research collaboration focusing on ultra-high-speed time-interleaved Pipelined/SAR Analog-to-Digital Converters (ADCs), background digital calibration algorithms, and low-jitter clock generation IP blocks in deep sub-micron CMOS nodes.

title: Smart City Phase-2
scope_text: Grant: ₹402.00 Lakhs (2024–2027, MeitY Govt. of India). Develops indigenous hardware and System-on-Chip platforms for Smart City Phase-2 deployments—integrating multi-protocol wireless sensor nodes, energy-harvesting PMICs, and secure edge-compute gateways for urban utilities, smart lighting, and environmental monitoring.

title: Energy Efficient Mesh Architecture Based Indigenous Neuromorphic Processor for Extreme Edge IoT
scope_text: Grant: ₹288.00 Lakhs (2023–2028, MeitY Chips-to-Startup / C2S). Designs an indigenous ultra-low-power neuromorphic processor ASIC based on a scalable 2D mesh Network-on-Chip (NoC) architecture. Implements leaky integrate-and-fire (LIF) Spiking Neural Networks (SNNs) with in-memory synaptic weights for sub-milliwatt always-on sensory inference at the extreme edge.

title: Design of Dynamic MAC and PHY SoC for low power and long-range networks
scope_text: Grant: ₹42.00 Lakhs (2020–2025, MeitY). Architects and fabricates a reconfigurable sub-GHz Low-Power Wide-Area Network (LPWAN) baseband PHY and MAC layer System-on-Chip. Supports dynamic modulation scaling (CSS/FSK/BPSK) and duty-cycled wake-up receivers to enable 10-year battery life in rural and agricultural IoT deployments.

Designs low-power, high-bandwidth wireline receiver front-ends in scaled CMOS technology for 28–56+ Gb/s serial links (SerDes). Combines inductorless Continuous-Time Linear Equalizers (CTLE) and speculative Decision Feedback Equalizers (DFE) to cancel severe inter-symbol interference (ISI) over lossy PCB backplanes.

Low power III-V Negative Capacitance FE for sensing applications

Integrates ferroelectric Hafnium Zirconium Oxide (HZO) negative-capacitance gate stacks onto high-mobility III-V compound semiconductor channels (InGaAs). Achieves steep sub-60 mV/decade subthreshold swing at room temperature to build ultra-high-sensitivity, low-power Ion-Sensitive and Dielectric-Modulated FET biosensors.

title: Machine Learning Augmented Compact Modeling of a Cryogenic Nanosheet FET for Analog Front-end Readout Circuitry
scope_text: Grant: ₹44.00 Lakhs (3 Years, SERB-CRG). Investigates carrier freeze-out, band-tail states, and quantum confinement in Gate-All-Around (GAA) stacked nanosheet FETs operating at deep cryogenic temperatures (4.2 K to 77 K). Pairs 3D TCAD quantum-transport simulations with neural networks to build industry-standard Verilog-A compact models for quantum processor cryo-CMOS readout circuits.

title: Reliability Aware Stacked Sheet FET Design Augmented with Machine Learning
scope_text: Grant: ₹20.00 Lakhs (2 Years, IIT Bhubaneswar Seed Grant). Evaluates electro-thermal self-heating, Bias Temperature Instability (BTI), and Hot Carrier Injection (HCI) degradation in sub-3 nm vertically stacked nanosheet transistors. Uses Machine Learning surrogate models to optimize sheet width, spacer dielectric, and inner-spacer geometry for 10-year circuit reliability.

title: Design and Development of Silicon power MOSFETs for EV Application
scope_text: Industry-Sponsored Project (iVP Semi, in collaboration with IIT Bombay). Designs and optimizes automotive-grade Silicon Trench-Gate and Shielded-Gate Power MOSFETs (40 V–150 V class) for EV traction inverters and DC-DC converters. Minimizes specific on-resistance (Rsp) and gate charge (Qg) while enhancing avalanche and short-circuit safe operating area (SOA).

title: Design and Characterization of SiC Trench MOSFETs for Next Generation Power Electronic Applications
scope_text: Grant: ₹72.00 Lakhs (2025–2028, ANRF-DST). Addresses premature gate-oxide breakdown at the trench corners of 1.2 kV–1.7 kV 4H-Silicon Carbide (4H-SiC) Trench MOSFETs. Develops novel p+ shielding implants and charge-sheet superjunction drift regions using 3D TCAD and experimental characterization to achieve ultra-low switching and conduction losses.

title: Simulation, Design and Feasibility Investigation of Superjunction based Power Devices in 4H-SiC
scope_text: Grant: ₹20.00 Lakhs (2025–2027, IIT Bhubaneswar Seed Grant). Formulates analytical 2D Poisson field solutions and TCAD process flows for Charge Sheet Superjunction (CSSJ) power diodes and MOSFETs in 4H-SiC. Replaces complex multi-epitaxial p-pillar regrowth with fixed negative charge layers at dielectric-SiC sidewalls to surpass the 1D SiC unipolar limit.

title: Investigation of Al2O3/SiO2 Interface on SiC Substrate for Charge Sheet Super Junction
scope_text: INUP-i2i Cleanroom Grant at IIT Bombay Nanofabrication Facility (2024–2026). Performs experimental cleanroom fabrication of Atomic Layer Deposited (ALD) Al2O3/SiO2 dielectric stacks on 4H-SiC substrates. Conducts high-temperature post-deposition annealing, C-V hysteresis, and I-V breakdown studies to quantify fixed negative interface charge density for superjunction termination.

title: Heavy Metal Ion Detector System for Water Quality Monitoring
scope_text: Grant: ₹23.52 Lakhs (SERB-SRG, Project RP362). Fabricates surface-functionalized metal-oxide and 2D nanomaterial chemiresistive/electrochemical sensor arrays coupled with a custom analog front-end potentiostat/readout circuit. Enables selective, parts-per-billion (ppb) field detection of toxic heavy metal ions (Arsenic, Lead, Mercury, Cadmium) in groundwater.

title: Self-powered Microsensors for Non-invasive Diabetes Monitoring
scope_text: Grant: ₹20.00 Lakhs (IIT Bhubaneswar Seed Grant, Project SP126). Develops room-temperature, self-powered nanostructured heterojunction gas microsensors that harvest energy from human breath airflow/humidity while selectively detecting sub-ppm acetone and isoprene volatile organic compounds (VOCs) for painless, non-invasive blood glucose monitoring.

title: Portable Real-time Sensor Unit for Trace Level Explosive Detection
scope_text: Grant: ₹39.52 Lakhs (2024–2027, IRDE DRDO). Builds a ruggedized, handheld electronic-nose sensor unit utilizing cross-reactive functionalized nanostructured sensor arrays and embedded pattern-recognition algorithms. Detects trace vapor signatures (ppb/ppt levels) of nitroaromatic explosives (TNT, RDX, DNT) in real time under ambient temperature and humidity variations.

title: Periodic Controller Design for Nonlinear Systems using High Gain Observer: Application to Coupled Tank System
scope_text: Grant: ₹20.00 Lakhs (Jan 2024–Jan 2026, IIT Bhubaneswar Seed Grant). Formulates continuous-time periodic feedback control laws integrated with nonlinear High-Gain Observers (HGO) to estimate unmeasured states and reject external disturbances. Experimentally validated on a laboratory four-tank / coupled-tank hydraulic process setup exhibiting non-minimum phase zeros.

title: Development of Beam Pointing System for Directed Energy Systems
scope_text: CHESS-DRDO Sponsored Defence Project. Designs high-bandwidth, robust closed-loop control algorithms (H-infinity, sliding-mode, and adaptive disturbance-observer control) for dual-axis piezoelectric/voice-coil Fast Steering Mirrors (FSM). Compensates for platform base-motion jitter and atmospheric turbulence to achieve micro-radian laser beam pointing accuracy in Directed Energy Weapon (DEW) systems.
